entries.quote: Enabled primarily by architectural improvements in AI systems, performance per dollar of AI compute is expected to improve >1000x by 2030.

entries.quote: DNA synthesis costs have dropped 100,000-fold (10⁵) and could continue to fall 10 million-fold (10⁷) by 2030.

entries.quote: Multiomics Performance Should Improve By Orders Of Magnitude By 2030 ... 100x decrease in cost to read DNA ... 1,000x decrease in cost to write DNA
entries.metric: decrease in cost to read DNA
entries.subject: Genome sequencing cost
entries.note: Same slide lists: 1,000x decrease in cost to write DNA; 4x decrease in cost to develop drugs; 5x higher return on R&D; 1.6x faster commercialization.

notes: Cover date February 4, 2025. Read from ARK Invest Europe's copy of the report (archived by the Internet Archive); the research.ark-invest.com link is also known. Skipped: about 20 claims without a number or without a date, for example 'Through 2030, we expect the amount of software deployed per knowledge worker to grow considerably', the knowledge-work adoption scenario table (three scenarios, not one forecast), fusion commercialization 'another ~15 years', US nuclear tripling by 2050 (a policy target, not an ARK forecast), and AI power demand compared with China's 2023 additions (no figure in text).
